profile_text.body:
Cerence Inc. is a public company headquartered in Burlington, Massachusetts, traded under the ticker CRNC. On its own site the company describes itself as delivering conversational and agentic AI-powered user experiences for automotive and beyond, built on CaLLM, which it describes as its family of language models. It says it provides tailor-made AI solutions that integrate with vehicle makers' systems while preserving their brand identity, and that it is moving to advance generative AI and LLM-powered innovation for automotive and transportation.

Among the products the site describes is Cerence Emergency Vehicle Detection, or Cerence EVD, which it says is already deployed in production vehicles and can detect and localize more than 1,500 emergency sirens across nearly 50 countries. According to the company, EVD identifies approaching emergency vehicles from more than 300 meters away using interior microphones and beyond 800 meters when paired with exterior microphones. The site also describes dynamic speech enhancement for multi-seat in-car environments, demonstrated by Timo Matheja and Stefan Hamerich, and work with Microsoft on Zero Trust and layered AI security for in-car assistants. In its third quarter results, the company reported revenue up 12% YoY, connected services revenue up 20% YoY, and operating cash flow of $20M supporting a first-ever share repurchase program.

Corporate records list the company's CIK as 0001768267. Its recorded legal exposure is in Massachusetts, with a count of 191.
